trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only missable trophy on the list. Eighteen Meditation Spots sit across ten locations, and the counter must reach 18. One Chapter 1 moment at Jason's house can be lost forever, so do it the first morning it appears and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.

steps.t: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 and keep it untouched until this trophy pops — there is no mission replay to recover a missed meditation.
Finish the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth (Meet Brian) and sleep at Jason's house until the next morning.
Walk into the kitchen the next morning and listen to Lucia say she is going to meditate.
Follow Lucia out onto the balcony, look at her, and choose Accept when the prompt appears.
Stay through the full meditation until the counter ticks up by 1 — this balcony moment is not marked as a Meditation Spot on the map.
Never advance past the end of Chapter 1 without doing the balcony meditation; it becomes impossible afterwards.
Open Touchpad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and confirm the counter moved.
From Chapter 2 on, meditate at every purple Meditation Spot icon you pass instead of saving them for cleanup.
Bring your partner to each spot: meditating at one spot with both Jason and Lucia together adds 2 to the counter.
Wait at each spot until the final zen animation finishes — leaving early does not register the meditation.
Work the spots county by county using the map filter Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida so none are skipped.
After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, return for the final meditation, which requires Jason and Lucia playing together.
Call your partner before the last spot: hold Right on the D-pad, then press Triangle / Y to bring them to you.
Meditate at the final spot with both characters present and let the animation complete.
Recheck Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and confirm the counter reads 18.
If the counter stalls below 18, revisit each of the ten locations and re-meditate with the character who has not meditated there.
Keep the Chapter 1 save in its slot until the trophy pops, in case the balcony meditation turns out to be required.
Note that the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18 meditations — this trophy, not the checklist, is the binding target.
Even in the worst case, a missed balcony meditation cannot cost you A Long Road — the checklist needs only 15 of the 18 spots.

disputes.a: OutputLag states flatly that Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation counts toward this trophy and disappears after the chapter.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and games.gg say the balcony moment is not a marked Meditation Spot and nobody has confirmed the trophy actually requires it — PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy.
disputes.call: Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save. It costs two minutes and removes the only missable risk on the entire list.

disputes.a: GTABase and OutputLag say meditating at one spot with both characters together counts twice, so paired visits fill the counter fastest.
disputes.b: Push Square describes 18 separate meditation locations and says a meditation at each one is needed, with completion only registering after the final zen animation.
disputes.call: Meditate with both characters at every spot and always wait for the zen animation — that satisfies both readings of the counter.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first trophy of the game, awarded by the opening story mission. It cannot be missed: finish Gone Fishing and it pops during the Chapter 1 opening stretch.

steps.t: Start a new game and play the prologue through to Jason's first playable mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission markers and complete every objective of Gone Fishing in order.
Do not use any cheat codes during the mission — cheats disable trophies and saving.
Watch the closing cutscene to the end; the trophy pops as the mission completes.
Make your first manual save right after the pop so the run has a clean Chapter 1 anchor.
Keep playing into Chapter 1 — the next story trophy, Paradise Lost, builds directly on this progress.
Gone Fishing is Jason's first mission of the game, so nothing before it can be missed or locked out.

disputes.a: GTAScoop calls Gone Fishing Jason's first mission and this the first trophy of the game.
disputes.b: GTA Zone describes it more cautiously as one of the first missions of Chapter 1.
disputes.call: Either way it is unmissable in the opening stretch — just play the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. Before you close the chapter, make sure the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude is done — it cannot be recovered later.

steps.t: Complete every Chapter 1 story mission in order, following the letter icons on the map.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth, before finishing the chapter.
Scan every new vehicle you pass with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then hold R1 / RB) to build Whip It Good progress early.
Study animals through the binoculars whenever the story takes you somewhere new — 100 of 255 are needed for the checklist.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 1 in a fresh slot; you will keep one save at the start and end of every chapter.
Finish the final Chapter 1 mission and let the chapter-close cutscene play out for the pop.
Before closing the chapter, bank Cal's fishing unlock and one home TV game — both live in Chapter 1 and feed later trophies.

disputes.a: Most lists tie the pop to completing Chapter 1's final mission.
disputes.b: OutputLag warns chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.
disputes.call: If it has not popped on the chapter's last cutscene, play the first minutes of Chapter 2 before worrying — the unlock is automatic either way.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's fishing questline opens in Chapter 1 after Feng Shui (Meet Cal). Follow his texts to the marked spot, work through his requests, and beat him in the head-to-head fishing challenge.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal) to unlock Cal's fishing questline.
Wait for Cal's text message, then open the map and travel to the purple fishing icon he marks.
Bring or hijack a boat fitted with a fishing rod — plenty float near the marked area if you have none.
Fish the marked area until you land the fish Cal asked for, following his quest prompts in order.
Keep accepting Cal's follow-up fishing requests as they arrive by text; they chain toward the challenge.
When the challenge starts, fish the same marked water and land fish steadily rather than chasing one big catch.
Watch the challenge timer and keep your line in the water — idle seconds lose more fish than slow reeling.
Beat Cal's total when the challenge ends; the trophy pops on the result screen.
If you lose, re-accept the challenge from Cal and fish the marked area again — it is repeatable and not missable.
Tick Fishing off your Master of None list: open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and confirm the fishing entry registered.

disputes.a: Push Square frames the unlock as a single early request: catch a Parrotfish over 2kg in the area Cal marks on your map.
disputes.b: PowerPyx describes a longer questline after Feng Shui (Meet Cal) that builds to a head-to-head challenge you must beat Cal in.
disputes.call: Follow Cal's whole questline from the first text — the 2kg Parrotfish reads like its opening step, and the challenge at the end is what the trophy description names.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish every level of any one of the four in-game video games. Three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth sits on arcade cabinets. One full game is enough — the per-game challenges are not required.

steps.t: From Chapter 1, walk to the TV at home and open the games menu.
Pick one game to finish completely: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV — any of the four in-game games counts.
Alternatively find an arcade cabinet and choose Bang For Your Buck — any one of the four games counts.
Play through every level of your chosen game in order; quitting mid-game does not complete it.
Ignore the optional in-game challenges attached to each title — they are not needed for this trophy.
Finish the final level and stay on the completion screen until the trophy pops.
Confirm the activity registered under Touchpad > Progress > Activities for Master of None.
Remember the checklist later wants all 4 video games played — trying the other three during cleanup is cheap progress.
If a level keeps failing, switch to a different one of the four games; only one completed game is required.
Do this in Chapter 1 while you are at home anyway — OutputLag's checklist groups it with the Chapter 1 tasks.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and OutputLag agree one fully completed game out of the four earns the trophy.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming's 100% checklist separately requires all 4 video games played, which can make the trophy look bigger than it is.
disputes.call: One finished game pops the trophy; play the other three later only because the 100% checklist counts them.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 story mission trophy. Breakfast Run also matters beyond the pop: character switching and partner play open up around it, which unlocks the partner trophies.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 until the Breakfast Run mission marker appears and start the mission.
Complete every objective of Breakfast Run in order and finish the mission.
Let the closing cutscene finish — the trophy pops on mission completion.
Test character switching as soon as the game offers it; partner play is available from this point of Chapter 2.
Call your partner once (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y) to learn the input every partner trophy uses.
Save manually at the next chapter boundary, keeping the start/end-of-chapter save pattern going.
Breakfast Run sits in Chapter 2's mandatory story sequence — it cannot be skipped, reordered, or missed.

disputes.a: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run, making it the unlock point for all partner trophies.
disputes.b: PowerPyx ties free-roam partner play and the partner trophies to the later Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break instead.
disputes.call: Try calling your partner right after Breakfast Run; if the option is greyed out, push on to Coffee Break — attempt partner trophies only once the call works.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 story mission. PowerPyx notes the pop lands after the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, rather than on Chapter 2's last cutscene — play on a few minutes before assuming anything is wrong.

steps.t: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission in order, including Breakfast Run and Coffee Break.
Use the newly unlocked partner play to meditate at spots with both characters, adding 2 per spot to the PMA counter.
Start the Billy questline when it appears at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break.
Meet Bret after Coffee Break when his text arrives and start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 2 in a fresh slot.
Play into Chapter 3's first mission, Welcome to Vice City — the Chapter 2 trophy pops after it, per PowerPyx's unlock note.
Chapter 2 also unlocks the garage app (Daily Driver) and the Scooter Bros app (Moses) — set both up before the chapter ends.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says this pops after Chapter 3's first mission, Welcome to Vice City — effectively one mission late.
disputes.b: The flat list descriptions on TrueAchievements and Insider Gaming simply say Complete Chapter 2, with no timing note.
disputes.call: Trust PowerPyx's timing note: finish Chapter 2, then complete Welcome to Vice City before checking the trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 3 story mission. Chapter 3 is also the unlock chapter for jewelry robberies, the Dye Pack Jammer, Randy's Wish List and Andy's questline — sweep those markers as they appear.

steps.t: Complete every Chapter 3 story mission in order, starting with Welcome to Vice City.
Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons).
Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for marked-bill robberies.
Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to get the Key Cloner and open Randy's Wish List.
Answer Andy's call when it comes and start his Belville questline while you are in the chapter.
Save manually at the end of Chapter 3, then finish the chapter's final mission for the pop.
Keep scanning new vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals through binoculars during Chapter 3 — checklist progress banks retroactively.

disputes.a: PowerPyx ties the Chapter 3 pop to finishing the chapter itself, with no extra mission named.
disputes.b: Following the pattern PowerPyx documented for Chapter 2's trophy landing one mission into the next chapter, a late pop into Chapter 4 would not be unusual.
disputes.call: Finish Chapter 3 and play the first Chapter 4 mission before concluding anything — chapter pops in this game can land late.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-path mission and cannot be missed; the trophy pops on completion.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist mission marker appears.
Stock up on armor and ammunition before starting — it is a full heist mission, not a cutscene.
Start The Cartel Heist and complete its setup objectives in the order the game presents them.
Push through the heist itself and escape with the crew when the job turns hot.
Finish the closing objective and let the mission-complete screen register the pop.
Bank the heist payout instead of spending it — garage money ($160,000) and van tips ($10,000) are coming in Chapter 4.
Save manually after the mission so a crash never costs you the heist.
The Cartel Heist is Chapter 3's set-piece mission on the detailed chapter trackers — it cannot be missed.

disputes.a: GTA Zone files Break the Bank as a Chapter 3 mission trophy.
disputes.b: Press Start and Insider Gaming list it among the story trophies without assigning a chapter at all.
disputes.call: Chapter assignment changes nothing in practice: it is a mandatory story mission and pops when you finish it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 4 story mission. PowerPyx places the pop after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, which it also names as the trigger for the final-mission Gold — expect both near the story's end.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 missions Ocean Beach and Another Life as they appear.
Work through the remaining Chapter 4 story missions in order: Child's Play, Headliners, and VCIA Takedown.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears — it unlocks bank vault robberies for three other trophies.
Keep a manual save from just before the chapter finale untouched; there is no mission replay.
Finish Starting From Zero, the final Chapter 4 mission, and let the closing cutscene play.
Confirm the pop, then save in a fresh slot before starting Chapter 5.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says this pops after Starting From Zero, Chapter 4's final mission.
disputes.b: EGamers, following Beebom and CULTR, words the endgame as a Chapter 5 structure, which blurs which chapter the finale belongs to.
disputes.call: Play Starting From Zero and the Chapter 5 opener back to back — the pop lands in that window regardless of how outlets label the chapters.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Main-path and unmissable; it pops on mission completion.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 until the Child's Play mission marker appears.
Start Child's Play and complete its objectives in order.
Finish the mission's final objective and watch the closing cutscene through.
Confirm the pop on the mission-complete screen.
Save manually after the mission to bank the progress.
Continue Chapter 4 — Headliners and VCIA Takedown carry their own trophies (DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked).
Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main-path mission — it cannot be missed or reordered.

disputes.a: GTA Zone assigns Child's Play to Chapter 4 explicitly.
disputes.b: Press Start lists Family Matters among the story trophies with no chapter given.
disputes.call: Treat it as a Chapter 4 main-path mission; it cannot be skipped or missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Main-path and unmissable; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 until the Headliners mission marker appears.
Start Headliners and work through its objectives in order.
Complete the final objective and let the closing cutscene finish.
Confirm the DWNFALL pop on the mission-complete screen.
Save manually after the mission.
Push on to VCIA Takedown, the next Chapter 4 trophy mission.
Headliners is a Chapter 4 main-path mission — it cannot be missed or reordered.

disputes.a: GTA Zone assigns Headliners to Chapter 4 explicitly.
disputes.b: GamesFuze and Press Start list DWNFALL by mission name only, with no chapter attached.
disputes.call: Chapter labels differ between outlets, but every list agrees it is a mandatory story mission — finish Headliners and it pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. While you are at VCIA for the story, note the docked jets at terminals E3 and E4 — you will steal one later for Catch Me If You Can.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 until the VCIA Takedown mission marker appears at the airport.
Start VCIA Takedown and complete its objectives in order.
Finish the final objective and let the mission-complete screen register the pop.
Before leaving the airport, scout terminals E3 and E4 and note which passenger jets sit docked at boarding bridges.
Note the stairs beside the boarding bridges — that is your entry route for the later jet theft.
Save manually after the mission.
Return to VCIA in free roam after the story to attempt Catch Me If You Can from the same terminals.
VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main-path mission — it cannot be missed or reordered.

disputes.a: GTA Zone assigns VCIA Takedown to Chapter 4 explicitly.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming and Press Start list Hi-Jacked among story trophies without a chapter.
disputes.call: It is a mandatory Chapter 4 story mission on the detailed lists — complete it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It sits deep in the final chapter, so keep an untouched manual save from just before the endgame until the credits roll.

steps.t: Play Chapter 5 until the Operation Savage Glory mission marker appears.
Make an untouched manual save before starting it — there is no mission replay if anything goes wrong.
Start Operation Savage Glory and complete its objectives in order.
Finish the final objective and watch the closing cutscene through.
Confirm the Snow Storm pop on the mission-complete screen.
Keep playing toward the final mission — You Gotta Know When to Get Off is next.
Do not overwrite your pre-endgame save until the credits have rolled and free roam resumes.
Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main-path mission — it cannot be missed or reordered.

disputes.a: GTA Zone assigns Operation Savage Glory to Chapter 5 explicitly.
disputes.b: Most flat lists give no chapter for Snow Storm at all, grouping it only as a story trophy.
disputes.call: Detailed chapter tracking puts it in Chapter 5 — either way it is mandatory and unmissable on the main path.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. The credits unlock free roam and the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats — everything you did during the story already counts toward it.

steps.t: Keep one manual save untouched from just before the final mission; there is no mission replay or New Game Plus.
Verify Positive Mental Attitude's Chapter 1 meditation is done — it is the only story-era beat that cannot be recovered later.
Start the final mission and complete every objective in order.
Watch the ending and credits to the end; the Gold pops on completion.
After the credits, open Touchpad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and read the checklist that just unlocked.
Confirm your story progress counted retroactively — robberies, scans, and discoveries from the campaign are already ticked.
Save in a fresh slot to mark the start of Stage 2, the checklist grind.
Never enable cheats on this save from here on — the post-story cleanup is where most trophies are earned.
Free roam continues after the credits and everything outside the story stays available — nothing but the Chapter 1 meditation was ever on a clock.

disputes.a: Insider Gaming's hidden list gives this trophy's description as Complete Chapter 5, wording the final mission as a chapter completion.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, TrueAchievements, and the other lists describe it as completing the final mission, and PowerPyx names that mission Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4's arc.
disputes.call: Finish the story to the credits. Whether the finale is filed as Chapter 4's last mission or Chapter 5's, the Gold pops when the campaign ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game: complete the in-game 100% checklist that appears under Progress > Stats after the story. It demands roughly 60% of everything the game tracks — all robberies in full, but only fractions of most collectibles. Budget about 100 hours for this stage alone.

steps.t: Finish the story, then open Touchpad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and screenshot the full checklist for planning.
Clear all 39 Gang Operations (yellow icons) — the checklist wants every one, not one per gang.
Fully complete all 22 Bank Jobs on the robbery tracker.
Fully complete all 7 Payday Loan Jobs.
Hit all 8 Bank Vaults — five pop Maximum Withdrawal, but the checklist counts all eight.
Work Smash 'N' Grabs and Stick Ups down the robbery tracker until both lines close out.
Complete 100 Optional Missions — purple icons plus black icons with pink letters count.
Find all 33 Underwater Discoveries; this line must be finished in full.
Earn all 42 Shooting Range gold medals across the ranges — this line is also The Shootist.
Complete all 42 Drone Races / time trials, not just one win per location.
Finish all 15 of Bret's Target Decks from Map > Activities > Target Deck.
Complete 300 stunts — 50 past the Cunning Stunts trophy line.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges, skipping the ten hardest.
Scan 100 WAiNK locations and complete 15 of the 18 Collectible Card sets.
Meditate at 15 spots, destroy 100 Cocaine Flamingos, and find 30 Magazines, Books and Comics.
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models with WAiNK and study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars.
Collect 50 of 66 Standard Issue Weapons and discover 70 of 79 Styles.
Win 30 unique races and 10 Race Challenge gold medals.
Beat 5 pool opponents, play Mini Golf at 2 locations, and score 90 basketball hoops.
Complete 5 of Kenton's 7 Treasure Sets and finish the fencing totals: $100k narcotics, $100k jewelry, $250k marked bills, $200k vehicles.
Tick the last open line and let the checklist hit 100% — the Gold pops when the tracker completes.
If a line looks stuck, re-read it in Progress > Stats: several lines count partial progress made during the story.
Close the Story Completion (100%) and Optional Tasks (100) lines — the full checklist holds 35 tasks in total.
Play all 4 video games — the checklist counts Video Games Played (4), three more than Stick Fiddler needs.
Study animals through the binoculars without killing them — dog and cat breeds count as separate entries toward the 100 studied.

disputes.a: PowerPyx counts 255 animals in the game, of which 100 must be studied for the checklist.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming's 100% walkthrough says there are over 160 animals to discover, while still requiring 100 of them.
disputes.call: The requirement is 100 studied either way — study everything you see through the binoculars and the line closes long before the pool runs out.

disputes.a: Insider Gaming lists 35 tasks on the checklist, with Smash 'N' Grabs fully completed at 34.
disputes.b: PowerPyx expresses the same robbery line as 34 of 35, implying a thirty-fifth exists that need not be completed.
disputes.call: Complete 34 Smash 'N' Grabs and check the in-game line — the game's own tracker, not any guide, decides when it closes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's Cellerica questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when he calls with his home address in Belville. Five quests run in a fixed order and the last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. The whole line stays available after the story.

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and answer Andy's call or text giving his home address in Belville.
Travel to Andy's house in Belville and start the questline in person.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3) in order as the first three quests.
Complete Pay the Cellerica Fee when it unlocks after the third part.
Complete Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation) next in the chain.
Complete Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and return the van as instructed.
Start the final quest, Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse), when Andy contacts you again.
Meet at the warehouse and complete Puff Puff Pass — the trophy pops at the end of Andy's final mission.
If a quest does not trigger, switch to Lucia — Jason cannot advance Andy's line.
Advance time or finish another activity between quests if Andy goes quiet; his follow-ups arrive by phone.
Do not count this strand toward Strangers & Freaks — Andy's line has its own trophy and is excluded from the eight.
If you skipped it during the story, return after the credits: the questline remains available in free roam.

disputes.a: GTAScoop names Andy's final mission directly: Puff Puff Pass.
disputes.b: PowerPyx lists the same five-quest chain ending in Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) but frames the trophy as the end of the whole Cellerica arc.
disputes.call: Both agree on the chain and its finale — run all five quests in order as Lucia and the trophy closes the line.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton Rees sends you diving on shipwrecks around Key Lento. Clear all seven wrecks, dig up each treasure with the metal detector, and return it — he keeps calling with new sets until his final mission closes the line.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) to open Kenton's questline.
Travel to the green KR icon in Key Lento and meet Kenton in person.
Dive at the first purple treasure-chest marker and search the shipwreck below.
Sweep the wreck with the metal detector and dig up the buried treasure it pings.
Return the recovered treasure to Kenton to close the first set.
Answer Kenton's follow-up calls and clear each new shipwreck set he marks — seven wrecks in total.
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1, push into Chapters 2–3 — he returns and texts Jason with more sets.
Speed the re-contact up by calling Brian as Jason during Chapter 2.
Clear the seventh wreck and dig up its treasure like the others.
Deliver the final treasure and complete Kenton's last mission — the trophy pops at the end of his line.
Remember the 100% checklist only needs 5 of Kenton's 7 sets, but this trophy needs his full questline finished.
Keep diving gear money aside: repeated wreck trips are the whole questline, so chain them county by county.
If a chest marker seems missing, surface and re-dive — the purple marker only renders near the wreck.

disputes.a: Push Square names Kenton's final mission outright: Maritime Disputes.
disputes.b: PowerPyx describes the line as a chain of treasure sets without naming a distinct finale mission.
disputes.call: Clear all seven wrecks and return every treasure; whether the finale is a named mission or the last set delivery, finishing Kenton's calls ends the line.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's Thrillbilly line opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Five jobs run from mud-club antics to stealing the Impaler, and the finale, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break, then travel to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County where Billy is marked.
Complete Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club) — the first of Billy's five jobs at the Mudclub — to open his job list.
Complete Twist Wrist when Billy offers it next.
Complete Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job) with Billy's crew.
Complete Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job) when it unlocks.
Complete The Impaler (Steal the Impaler) and deliver the car as instructed.
Start the finale, Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job), when Billy calls you back.
Finish Hometown Heroes — Push Square confirms it as Billy's final mission and the trophy pop.
If Billy goes quiet between jobs, finish another activity and wait for his next call.
Do not count Billy's strand toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy and is excluded from the eight.
If you skipped the Mudclub during the story, the whole line stays open after the credits.

disputes.a: Push Square names Hometown Heroes as the Billy mission that unlocks the trophy.
disputes.b: PowerPyx lists Hometown Heroes as the last of five Billy jobs, with the trophy at the end of the whole line.
disputes.call: Same conclusion from both: run all five jobs in order and the finale pops it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List: steal and deliver sixteen specific cars to his garage in west Vice City. The list unlocks with the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, and hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the richest hunting ground.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) to unlock the Key Cloner and the Wish List.
Note the Granforma Zorrusso is delivered automatically by that mission — one of sixteen already done.
Open Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List and read the fifteen remaining target cars — every delivery goes to Randy's garage in west Vice City, marked with the green RK icon.
Hold Up to open WAiNK and hold R1 / RB to scan any parked car — the app tells you if it is on the list.
Hunt the hotel driveways and valet rows of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where the listed models spawn most often.
Steal the Pegassi Vitello and drive it to the green RK icon at Randy's garage in west Vice City.
Deliver the Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, and Pegassi Toros to the RK garage the same way as you find them.
Deliver the Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, and Ocelot Jagular to the RK garage in west Vice City.
Deliver the Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, and Pfister Growler to the RK garage.
Deliver the Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, and Benefactor Dubsta to the RK garage.
Deliver the final two to the RK garage: the Bravado Banshee and the Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Drive every delivery in clean — undamaged cars pay more, and the money funds garages and van tips.
If a model will not spawn, cycle the hotel rows at different times of day and re-scan traffic with WAiNK.
Check the Wish List counter after each delivery under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
Deliver the sixteenth car — Randy's final delivery completes his line and pops the trophy.
Do not count Randy's strand toward Strangers & Freaks; it carries its own trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase both fix the Wish List at 16 cars, with the Zorrusso auto-delivered by the unlock mission.
disputes.b: Push Square only says the trophy unlocks after completing all of Randy's missions, pointing to a separate Wish List locations guide for the cars.
disputes.call: Work to the number: 16 delivered cars, tracked in Map > Robberies, is the verifiable finish line.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. First you burn his marked Synthetic Labs across Vice City; once enough are gone, his second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), awards the trophy.

steps.t: Play as Jason and complete Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty to mark Tyrone's questline.
Start Take Out Kitty Litter and travel to the first Synthetic Lab — the labs are marked in purple around Vice City.
Destroy the lab equipment at each marked site until the site registers as shut down.
Work through every marked lab in Vice City — Tyrone counts them before offering the finale.
Bring explosives or heavy weapons; labs are defended and destruction, not stealth, is the objective.
Escape the area after each lab so the next marker can register cleanly.
Accept Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), when he contacts you.
Shut down the remaining labs in the finale and complete the quest — the trophy pops at its end.
If Tyrone will not call, switch to Jason — Lucia cannot advance his line.
Do not count Tyrone's strand toward Strangers & Freaks; it is excluded and carries its own trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx structures Tyrone's line as two quests: Take Out Kitty Litter, then Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) for the trophy.
disputes.b: GTAScoop simply credits the trophy to completing Tyrone's final mission, named Spin On This.
disputes.call: Destroy labs until Tyrone offers the Spin On This quest, then finish it — both accounts end at the same finale.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only: Lucia never gets his text. He hands you his unique rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, and sends you after animals on his Target Decks. Which single animal triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed — his full deck list is required for 100% anyway.

steps.t: Play as Jason after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and wait for Bret's text — Lucia never receives it.
Travel to the marked Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) start in Lummox County and meet Bret in person.
Take Bret's unique hunting rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69; if you lose it, retrieve it free from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Open Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck and read the first target animal and its hunting ground.
Travel to the marked hunting ground as Jason and track the target animal.
Line up one clean shot — a single-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, though it is not mandatory.
Deliver the animal to Bret as instructed to close the deck.
Repeat deck by deck: all 15 Target Decks are required for the 100% checklist regardless of this trophy.
Study each new species through the binoculars before shooting — 100 animals studied is also a checklist line.
If the trophy has not popped after several decks, keep going: the triggering unique animal is still unconfirmed in every guide.
Check deck progress under Map > Activities > Target Deck after each delivery.
Use the SM-69 for deck hunts; its scope makes the one-shot pristine window far easier.
Hunt at the marked grounds rather than roaming — deck animals only count at their designated spots.
Finish the deck containing the unique animal and the trophy pops on delivery to Bret.
Study each deck animal through the binoculars before the hunt — studying never requires a kill and banks the checklist's animal line.
Aim for the head or heart on deck hunts — one clean shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase, and GTA Zone all state the exact animal that triggers this trophy is not yet confirmed.
disputes.b: The trophy description itself only says hunt a unique animal for Bret, and OutputLag notes one clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine without confirming it matters.
disputes.call: Hunt Bret's decks with clean one-shot kills as Jason. The trophy will land on one of the 15 decks you must finish for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger strands count toward the eight — the character lines with their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone, and friends) do not. The confirmed counters are Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete, with more still being verified. Watch the trophy's own progress counter after every strand.

steps.t: Open the trophy in your trophy list and note its progress counter — it is the only reliable scoreboard for which strands count.
Start Kirk's strand — one of the four confirmed counting strands: complete Search for the Skunk Ape and Skunk Apeology 101 as they appear.
Continue Kirk's strand with Search for Tree Effigies.
Finish Kirk's strand with Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove and Advanced Skunk Apeonomics.
Start Kyle's strand — another confirmed counter — with Check Out McKittrick Farm.
Continue Kyle's strand with Collect Chemicals for Kyle, then Buddy? (Check on Kyle).
Start Yago's strand — a confirmed counter — with Join a Street Race, then Bumper to Bumper (Mentor Yago).
Save before Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 — it carries a timer icon and is time-sensitive, so run it the moment it appears.
Finish Yago's strand with Brother to Brother (Back Up Yago).
Start Pilot Pete's strand — the fourth confirmed counter — with The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, then The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot.
Continue Pete's strand with Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield and Pete's Deliveries: Avery Allen & Co.
Finish Pete's strand with Deliver Packages.
Check the trophy counter after each finished strand and keep completing stranger strands until it reads 8.
Skip Moses, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Tyrone, and Eddie lines for this count — they do not advance the counter.
If you run short, keep sweeping stranger markers in free roam after the story — all strands stay available and more are still being confirmed as counters.
Do not grind strands for A Long Road — stranger quests appear nowhere on the 100% checklist.
Do strands as you find them rather than saving them all for cleanup — it spreads the work across the whole run.

disputes.a: GTA Zone and games.gg state the counters plainly: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, and Billy do not.
disputes.b: PowerPyx lists the same four confirmed strands but notes more strands are still being discovered, so the full counting set is not closed.
disputes.call: Finish the four confirmed strands first, then verify each further strand against the trophy's own progress counter before investing hours.

disputes.a: GTAScoop's tips claim the eight stranger strands count toward Strangers & Freaks and 100% Completion.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and GTA Zone are explicit that stranger quests are not on the 100% checklist at all.
disputes.call: Trust the checklist itself: open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion in game — stranger strands appear nowhere on it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one attempt each. Most register the moment you start them, so this is a one-hour sweep across the map filters once you know the list.

steps.t: Open the map and set the filter to Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to see every activity marker near you.
Go fishing once — Cal's Chapter 1 questline already covers this if you did Baited My Tackle.
Go hunting once — any of Bret's Target Deck hunts covers this.
Play one round of Golf at any course marker.
Enter one Shooting Range challenge at any range.
Play one game of Pool against any opponent.
Score one hoop at any Basketball court.
Play one Video Game — the TV at home covers this and works toward Stick Fiddler.
Enter one race: a Car Race, a Race Challenge, or a Top Fun Drone Race all count as the racing type — the nine types count racing once.
Perform one Stunt — any Stunt Jump, Under the Bridge flight, Knife Flight, or Base Jump registers.
Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and verify all nine types show an attempt.
If one type is missing, its map marker is the blue dumbbell — filter and travel to the nearest one.
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers — no wins or medals are required, only attempts.

disputes.a: PowerPyx lists the nine types with racing as a single type covering car races, race challenges, and drone races.
disputes.b: HowToVideoGame and GamesFuze confirm the count of nine activity types without enumerating them.
disputes.call: Work PowerPyx's enumerated list of nine and verify each in Progress > Activities — the in-game tracker settles any list difference.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, and 25 Base Jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest filler. Keep going afterwards — the 100% checklist wants 300.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities > Stunts and note your starting count — story play already banked some.
Set the map filter to Exploration > Stunt Spots to see every discovered stunt marker.
Take a plane and chain Under the Bridges flights — at 202 available they are the deepest and quickest pool.
Fly each bridge clean through the marked gap and emerge unscathed on the other side; clipping the structure fails the attempt.
Work Stunt Jumps in a fast car county by county, hitting each ramp at full speed.
Attempt Knife Flights between the marked tall buildings in Vice City, rolling the plane 90 degrees through the gap.
Finish Base Jumps by leaping from the marked peaks and buildings, dropping through the checkpoints, and parachuting onto the target.
Skip any stunt that keeps failing — you need 250 of 397, so the hardest third is optional.
Ignore the per-jump stunt challenges attached to Stunt Jumps; they are not required for this trophy.
Recheck the Stunts counter after every session so sessions end on a known number.
The trophy pops at 250 completed stunts.
Keep going to 300 afterwards — A Long Road's checklist line sits 50 past this trophy.
Mix categories instead of exhausting one: games.gg advises picking whichever categories you find easiest.
There is no per-category quota — any 250 of the 397 stunts count toward the trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and Push Square break the 397 down identically: 130 jumps, 202 bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
disputes.b: OutputLag's grind summary names the four categories without counts, only warning not to stop at 250 because the checklist needs 300.
disputes.call: The category counts agree where given; plan for 300 from the start so the trophy is a waypoint, not a finish line.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges must end in gold. The ranges also raise your Focus level, so this Silver quietly makes Gunslinger easier. Every gold is also a hard requirement of the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Activities > Shooting Ranges and note which of the 42 challenges you have already golded during the story.
Travel to Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn — one of the two ranges that hold the 42 challenges — and open its challenge list.
Clear each Rodgers Ranch challenge at its bronze tier first to learn the target patterns.
Re-run each challenge at the higher tiers and finish with a gold medal score.
Travel to Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, the second of the two ranges, and repeat the tier-by-tier sweep.
Check challenge unlock conditions on the map — some challenges stay locked until earlier ones are done.
Work every range on the map until the gold count under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges climbs toward 42.
Use range sessions to raise your Focus level — the same practice feeds Gunslinger later.
If a gold score keeps slipping, finish the run anyway and re-enter immediately while the pattern is fresh.
Count golds, not completions: a silver finish does not advance this trophy.
The trophy pops on the 42nd gold medal.
Confirm the same 42 golds closed the matching line on the 100% checklist.
GamesFuze pairs this with A Long Road as the two hardest trophies — schedule it early in Stage 2, not last.
If your gold count stalls below 42, sweep the map's Shooting Ranges filter for a range or tier you have not visited yet.

disputes.a: GTA Zone and PowerPyx describe 42 golds spread across 12 shooting ranges.
disputes.b: Push Square and OutputLag describe two range locations — Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero — holding the 42 challenges between them.
disputes.call: The medal count is identical everywhere: 42 golds. Sweep ranges from the map's Shooting Ranges filter until the counter reads 42, wherever they sit.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: One win at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. The checklist later wants all 42 drone races completed — this trophy only needs the 14 wins.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones and list the locations you have discovered — there are 14 to win.
Carry cash — some Top Fun locations charge an entry fee before the race starts.
Travel to the first location, pay any fee, and start the drone race.
Fly the checkpoint line cleanly and finish first to bank the location win.
Repeat at each of the 14 locations, ticking them off the map list as you win.
If you lose a race, re-enter immediately — only wins count, attempts cost nothing but the fee.
Discover missing locations by exploring with the Activities filter on; undiscovered spots cannot be won.
The trophy pops on your fourteenth location win.
Keep racing afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road — the checklist counts all 42 drone races completed.
Bank the racing type for Master of None: a Top Fun entry counts as your racing activity.
The checklist's 42 Drone Time Trials are these same races — every Top Fun race you finish banks progress for A Long Road too.

disputes.a: Push Square fixes 14 Top Fun locations and notes some require entry fees.
disputes.b: GTA Zone frames the same target as one win at each of the 14 spots, with all 42 races reserved for the 100% checklist.
disputes.call: Fourteen location wins pop the trophy; the 42-race total only matters for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different race wins out of the 40 on offer — repeating the same race does not advance the counter. Hired cars are allowed; if you bring your own, its Rating matters and Mod Shops improve it.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Activities > Racing and list the race locations you have discovered — 40 races exist and you need 20 different wins.
Start with races near your current position and win each one once.
Hire the offered car when your own vehicle's Rating is low — Push Square notes most locations allow hires.
If you race your own car, upgrade it at a Mod Shop first to raise its Rating.
Never re-run a won race for this trophy — the counter only moves on first-time wins at new locations.
Track distinct wins under Progress > Activities > Racing after each session — repeats never move the counter.
Explore with the Racing filter on to discover the remaining locations across Leonida.
The trophy pops on your twentieth different race win.
Keep going to 30 unique wins if you are chasing the checklist, which counts 30 for A Long Road.
Bank the racing activity type for Master of None with your first entry.
Keep Race Challenge gold medals (10 for the checklist) mentally separate from unique race wins (30 for the checklist) — they are different lines on the tracker.

disputes.a: Every detailed list agrees repeats do not count: 20 different races of the 40 available.
disputes.b: The flat trophy description alone — Win 20 different races — is the only place the rule appears on TrueAchievements, with no method attached.
disputes.call: No real conflict: win once at 20 separate locations and verify distinct wins in Progress > Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty of the game's 80 Challenges. Most complete themselves during normal play; check the list under Progress > Challenges and deliberately mop up the near-finished ones. The checklist wants 70, so treat 50 as a waypoint.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Challenges and sort by the ones closest to completion.
Note the completed checkmark shown at the bottom-right of each finished challenge.
Play normally through Stage 2 — robbery, stunt, and racing work finishes many challenges on its own.
Target the nearly-done challenges first; each needs only its last few actions.
Skip any challenge that resists — you need 50 of 80, so thirty can be ignored entirely.
Recheck the Challenges screen after every play session and bank the new completions.
The trophy pops on your fiftieth completed challenge.
Continue to 70 completions for the A Long Road checklist line.
Leave the ten hardest challenges alone even at 70 — the checklist allows exactly that skip.
Before grinding any single challenge, re-read the full list — many complete themselves during normal play, so your real mop-up list is shorter than it looks.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and HowToVideoGame frame the ladder as 50 for the trophy and 70 of 80 for the checklist.
disputes.b: GTABase adds that many challenges complete themselves while you play, so the deliberate mop-up is smaller than it looks.
disputes.call: Both hold: play the checklist grind first, then deliberately finish only the near-complete challenges left under 50.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: One Combat Focus activation, five enemy takedowns. Buff your Focus bar first, extend it with Adrenaline, and line the shot up at a Gang Operation where gang members cluster — police, soldiers, and civilians do not count.

steps.t: Raise your Focus level first: Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, fishing, and headshots all build it — fishing alone adds roughly 10% per landed fish.
Check your Focus level under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus (the purple eye) and fill the purple bar before attempting this.
Top the bar up at home: eat, drink, wash your face, or shower to buff Focus.
Carry Adrenaline and an assault rifle such as the Duke 556, and wear body armor — every detailed guide prescribes an assault rifle for the five-kill window.
Travel to a Gang Operation (yellow icon) where at least five gang members stand in one sightline.
Take Adrenaline (hold L1, then press Triangle / Y) to extend the Focus window before you aim.
Aim at the group and press L3 + R3 together to trigger Combat Focus.
Drop five gang members before the purple bar drains — sweep targets in one direction without re-aiming from scratch.
Do not waste the window on police, soldiers, or civilians; they do not count toward the five.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown inside the single activation.
If the bar runs dry at four, refill Focus and retry at the next Gang Operation — operations respawn for cleanup.
Practise the L3 + R3 input on a lone target first — Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion aim and the real attempt is no place to learn it.

disputes.a: OutputLag adds a precise Focus economy: each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter.
disputes.b: PowerPyx lists food, drinks, washing up, shooting ranges, golf, pool, and headshots as the Focus builders, without the fishing percentage.
disputes.call: Combine both: fish and eat to top the bar, take Adrenaline, then spend it all in one Gang Operation window.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs Jason and Lucia together, so the earliest window is Chapter 2 partner play. The reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — and every bank vault robbery hands you a free 4-star attempt.

steps.t: Wait until partner play is open, then call your partner: hold Right on the D-pad, then press Triangle / Y.
Commit crimes together until the Wanted Level reaches 4 stars.
Drive for the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police cannot follow along the tracks.
Stay inside the tunnel until the helicopter loses sight of you and the search collapses.
Leave the red heat zone completely — exiting only the flashing search area is not enough.
The trophy pops once you are fully out of the heat with your partner still with you.
Shortcut: rob any bank vault with your partner — vaults give an instant 4 stars, and the escape counts the same way.
Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… therefore doubles as a Hot Together attempt.
If your partner gets separated mid-escape, regroup before leaving the heat zone.
If the attempt fails, raise 4 stars again and repeat the tunnel run — it is endlessly repeatable.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase both name the Ambrosia train tunnel as the easiest escape and stress leaving the red heat zone.
disputes.b: OutputLag emphasises the distinction itself: clearing the flashing search area is not enough for this or A Classic Blitz Play.
disputes.call: Same rule from both sides: tunnel, wait out the search, then drive until the red heat shading is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in one unbroken wanted streak, with your partner beside you. The flashing red-and-blue wanted level must never drop — the red heat zone alone does not keep the chain alive. The three north Vice City jewelry stores are the tightest route.

steps.t: Call your partner first: hold Right on the D-pad, then press Triangle / Y — solo robberies do not count.
Equip an armored vest and stock sticky bombs, Zombix, and Adrenaline before starting the chain.
Wait until Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs are done so the three north Vice City jewelry stores are open.
Rob the first jewelry store thoroughly: loot the items on display and blow the back-room safe with the sticky bombs you brought.
Make sure police have actually arrived and the flashing red-and-blue wanted level is active before you leave store one.
Drive straight to the second store and rob it while the wanted level is still flashing — never let it fade to the red heat zone.
Rob the third store the same way, keeping the streak unbroken between all three.
Leave the third shop and wait — the pop is delayed by roughly 30 seconds.
If nothing pops after the wait, rob a fourth shop without losing the wanted level; a slow first store is the usual cause.
Escape the heat only after the trophy pops, so the chain is never at risk.
If the wanted level drops mid-chain, restart the three-store run — partial chains do not bank.

disputes.a: games.gg draws the line precisely: staying inside the red heat zone without an active flashing Wanted Level does not satisfy the condition.
disputes.b: PowerPyx phrases the same requirement as never losing the Wanted Level and warns the pop trails the third shop by about 30 seconds.
disputes.call: Keep the stars flashing between stores and give the trophy its 30 seconds before judging the attempt.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Unlocked by Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which hand you the Snap Gun. Enter through the back door with it, find the safe-code note inside, and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the proven target.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to receive the Snap Gun and unlock Jewelry Store Robberies.
Confirm the Snap Gun sits in your permanent inventory — it never needs equipping.
Travel to Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City, a recommended quiet target.
Walk to the store's locked back door and choose the Snap Gun prompt to open it silently.
Never kick the back door — kicking triggers the alarm and voids the attempt instantly.
Search the back room for the note carrying the safe code.
Open the safe with the code and take everything inside without being seen by staff or cameras.
Leave through the back door the way you came in.
The trophy pops once the robbery completes with no detection.
If you are spotted, reload your save and repeat the same store — OutputLag lists this as a classic mistake to avoid persisting with.
Afterwards, jewelry stores stay open as green-icon robberies for money and Retail Therapy routes.
If the back door shows no Snap Gun prompt, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs are not finished yet — the tool and the prompt arrive together in Chapter 3.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, OutputLag, and games.gg all name Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds as a good target and the Snap Gun back-door route as the method.
disputes.b: The flat lists give only the description — rob a jewelry store without being detected — with no route at all.
disputes.call: Follow the detailed consensus: Snap Gun, back door, code note, safe, out the back — at Richardson's.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is…. Tail a security van to its bank, enter while the vault stands open, and split the bags with your partner — one character cannot carry it all. Five of eight vaults pop this; the checklist wants all eight.

steps.t: Start Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) when it appears.
Tail the security van at a distance until it stops at its bank.
Enter the bank while the vault door stands open during the delivery.
Bring your partner inside — the haul is too heavy for one character to carry alone.
Hand a bag to your partner (hold Right on the D-pad) so both of you carry a share.
Escape the instant 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to break the search.
Leave the red heat zone fully — this same escape also satisfies Hot Together and A Classic Blitz Play.
After the mission, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 — he requires his two Payday Loan jobs done first.
Follow each purple van icon Yasmani sells you and repeat the tail-and-enter routine at the next bank.
Rob vaults two, three, and four the same way, banking up to $205,000 per vault.
Rob the fifth vault and escape — the Silver pops on the fifth clean getaway.
Continue to all eight vaults afterwards; A Long Road's checklist counts every one.
Track vaults hit under the robbery section of Progress so no bank is repeated by mistake.
Keep a fast bike staged near each target bank before you start the tail.
If a tail breaks, buy a fresh tip from Yasmani rather than hunting vans blindly.
Expect an instant 4-star wanted level the moment any vault opens — stage the escape bike before you go in.
Time vault attempts with armored truck deliveries — the delivery is what gets the vault open in the first place.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and OutputLag place the vault unlock in an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is….
disputes.b: Sixshore's summary says bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4 as well, but GTA Zone's table only notes vaults open with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars.
disputes.call: All agree on Chapter 4's optional mission as the key — do That's Where The Money Is… the moment it appears.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The free method: any bank vault robbery counts as robbing an armored truck, so this pops during Maximum Withdrawal work. The early method is a roaming truck, a blocked road, and a sticky bomb on the rear doors.

steps.t: Easiest path: rob any bank vault after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… — the game counts it as an armored truck robbery.
Escape the red heat zone after the vault job and the trophy pops with the getaway.
Early alternative: buy sticky bombs from Yasmani's shop after finishing his quests.
Hunt a roaming armored truck on the roads near banks, where they circulate most.
Block the truck's path with your vehicle so it stops.
Plant a sticky bomb on the truck's rear doors and detonate it to blow them open.
Grab the money from the back of the truck.
Escape the red heat radius completely, or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray to clear the heat.
The trophy pops once you are clear with the money.
If you already finished Maximum Withdrawal, check your trophy list — this one almost certainly popped along the way.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase, and OutputLag all confirm a bank vault robbery counts toward this trophy automatically.
disputes.b: GTA Zone phrases it conditionally — a bank vault job counts if you get away — keeping the standalone truck method as the literal reading.
disputes.call: Do one vault robbery with a clean escape first; only hunt a roaming truck if the trophy somehow has not popped.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, one robbed Illegal Operation each. The operations are the yellow map icons; the Progress > Gangs screen tracks the count per gang so you never rob the same gang twice by mistake. The checklist wants all 39.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Gangs and note the per-gang operation counts (bottom-right of each gang entry).
Set the map to show Illegal Operations — they are the yellow icons across Leonida.
Travel to an operation belonging to a gang whose count still reads zero.
Rob the operation: clear or slip past its guards and take the valuables inside.
Escape the area and confirm the gang's count rose to 1 in Progress > Gangs.
Repeat gang by gang until all nine gangs show at least one robbed operation.
Use Gang Operations as your Gunslinger stage — their clustered guards are the best Combat Focus targets.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's first operation is robbed.
Keep clearing operations afterwards: the 100% checklist requires all 39.
Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is one gang's operation — rob it thoroughly for Let's Go Bowling while you are there.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase, and GTA Zone agree on the shape: 9 gangs, 39 operations, one per gang for the trophy and all 39 for the checklist.
disputes.b: OutputLag's summary folds Pest Control into the checklist grind without separating the trophy's one-per-gang rule.
disputes.call: Track it per gang in Progress > Gangs — one robbery for each of the nine names, then grind the rest for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any three of the eighteen Collectible Card sets. Pick the three shortest sets and sweep them location by location; the checklist later demands fifteen, so every card you pick up now is banked progress.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards and compare how close each of the 18 sets already is.
Choose the three sets with the fewest missing cards as your trophy targets.
Sweep the first set's locations one by one, picking up every card you are missing.
Check the set's progress in Progress > Collections after each pickup so no card is hunted twice.
Complete the first set in full — partial sets do not count toward the three.
Sweep the second target set the same way until it completes.
Sweep the third target set until it completes — the Silver pops on the third finished set.
Sell spare collected cards at Pawn Shops if you need cash — Push Square confirms sold cards still count toward set progress.
Keep collecting beyond three sets during cleanup: the 100% checklist requires 15 completed sets.
Combine card sweeps with WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries in the same districts to triple-bank progress.
If a set stalls one card short, re-filter the map to that set and revisit its locations in order.

disputes.a: Push Square adds a money-saving detail: cards already collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still contribute to your progress.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and the other guides describe completing sets without mentioning selling collected cards at all.
disputes.call: Sell duplicates freely if Push Square's note holds in your game — but verify the set counter does not drop on your first sale before clearing your inventory.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — more than 100 exist, so skip any that are awkward to reach. The checklist counts the same 100.

steps.t: Hold Up on the D-pad to open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Aim at a scannable location and hold R1 / RB until the scan completes.
Open Touchpad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations and note your starting count.
Sweep Landmarks first — 31 of them sit at the state's most obvious sights.
Sweep Curiosities next; at 35 they are the deepest single pool.
Sweep Sculptures — 23 are scattered through the cities and parks.
Scan No Flusher Tags whenever you spot one to top the count up.
Work district by district instead of crossing the map for single scans.
Recheck the WAiNK Locations counter after each district sweep.
The trophy pops on your hundredth completed scan — any mix of the four types counts.
The same 100 scans close the WAiNK line on the 100% checklist, so nothing here is wasted.
Scan vehicles with the same app while you travel between locations — Whip It Good uses the identical input.
There is no per-type quota — any 100 scans from the four types count, so skip whichever locations are awkward to reach.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase, Push Square, and GTA Zone break the pool down identically: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.
disputes.b: Push Square lists the No Flusher Tag count as unknown, so the exact total pool size is unconfirmed.
disputes.call: The named pools alone give 89 scans; tags and any surplus locations carry you past 100 without needing an exact pool total.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you never need to drive them. Stand beside a busy road and scan traffic as it passes. The checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new.

steps.t: Hold Up to open WAiNK, then hold R1 / RB aimed at any vehicle you have not discovered to scan it.
Open Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles and note your starting discovery count.
Stand beside a busy Vice City road and scan every passing model you have not seen.
Walk hotel driveways and parking lots in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, scanning parked rows.
Scan Randy's Wish List models whenever you find them — the same cars serve two trophies.
Travel between counties; rural and industrial districts spawn models the city never shows.
Getting into a vehicle also discovers it, so any car you steal for a job counts twice toward your habits.
Recheck Progress > Vehicles after each sweep and chase the missing models by district.
The trophy pops on your hundredth discovered vehicle.
Keep scanning to 200 base models afterwards — A Long Road's checklist counts exactly that line.
Scan traffic as you drive between objectives — discoveries bank passively and most of the 100 arrive naturally during the story.
Guides that track natural progress list this among the trophies that pop on their own on the way to 100% — only mop up the tail deliberately.

disputes.a: Push Square says a vehicle is discovered when you get inside one or scan one — both routes count.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and GTABase present the WAiNK scan as the discovery method, with scanning alone being sufficient.
disputes.call: Scan everything — it is faster than entering cars, and if entering also counts, your story driving has been banking progress all along.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the black fog from the entire map. The fastest method is a plane: fly slow, methodical passes over every remaining dark patch until no fog is left anywhere in Leonida.

steps.t: Open the full map and identify every region still covered by black fog.
Steal or buy access to a plane — flying is the fastest way to unfog large areas.
Fly a slow grid over the largest fog patch first, watching the map edge clear as you cross it.
Drop to lower altitude over stubborn patches; height alone does not always register exploration.
Work county by county: the Keys and the south-west islands are the easiest to forget.
Land and drive or walk any small fog slivers that flying leaves behind, especially in dense city blocks.
Reopen the map after each flight and re-mark what remains before taking off again.
The trophy pops when the final fog patch clears and all of Leonida is explored.
Combine unfog flights with Under the Bridge stunts and vehicle scans in the same districts.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase, and GTA Zone all prescribe the same method: a plane over the black-fog areas is fastest.
disputes.b: The flat lists state only the requirement — explore all of Leonida — with no method or fog mechanic described.
disputes.call: Follow the detailed consensus: fly the fog off county by county, then mop up slivers on the ground.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A cumulative money total, not a single score. Marked Bills come from bank and Payday Loan robberies once the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks in Chapter 3, and fences convert them — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone can nearly finish this.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob Banks and Payday Loan jobs to start collecting Marked Bills as loot.
Carry the Marked Bills to a Fence contact instead of spending them raw.
Sell to Yasmani in Vice City where possible — he pays the most of the fences.
Watch the laundered total climb; the counter is cumulative across your whole run.
Prioritise bank vault robberies from Chapter 4 — a single vault can pay up to $205,000, most of this trophy in one job.
Fence the vault haul's marked bills immediately so the laundering total registers.
Keep robbing banks and Payday Loans between other Stage 2 work; the checklist needs those robbery lines anyway.
Note the identical $250,000 Marked Bills Fenced line on the 100% checklist — this trophy and that line finish together.
The trophy pops when the cumulative laundered total reaches $250,000.
If the total crawls, chain Payday Loan jobs — they are quick and their bills all feed the same counter.
Never spend Marked Bills before fencing them; only laundered money counts.
The robbery lines you must finish for 100% anyway generate marked bills the whole way — this total normally completes itself during the checklist grind.
Fence in small batches whenever you pass a contact — the $250,000 is cumulative, so no trip is ever wasted.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTA Zone name Yasmani as the best-paying fence for marked bills.
disputes.b: OutputLag describes the system generically — marked bills are laundered by selling them to your contacts — without ranking fences.
disputes.call: Sell through Yasmani when you are in Vice City; use other fences only when the trip would cost more time than the price difference.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A cumulative spend across every shop type in the game. Guns, car mods, and tattoos burn money fastest. You will cross this naturally while gearing up for Stage 2 — the trick is only to spend in shops, not on property.

steps.t: Open the map with the Style filter to see shop locations, as Push Square suggests for finding stores.
Buy weapons and ammunition at Ammu-Nation — 24 stores statewide, and every purchase feeds the same cumulative counter.
Modify a car at a Mod Shop (14 statewide) — full performance and cosmetic builds drain cash quickly.
Buy clothing across the 67 Clothing Stores and 17 Footwear Stores as you pass them — small shops still feed the same cumulative total.
Use the 18 Hair & Beauty Salons and 11 Tattoo Studios for steady mid-size spending toward the same total.
Respray and repair at the 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and shop the 15 Electronics Stores when nearby — it all adds up across every kind of shop.
Keep a running mental total — the counter is cumulative across all shop types, not per store.
The trophy pops when your all-shops total reaches $100,000.
Do not count garage purchases toward this — Little Boxes money is property spending, tracked separately.
Remember the counter is a running total across every shop in the game — there is no per-store or per-type quota to satisfy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx itemises the shop network: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear, 18 Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics.
disputes.b: Push Square gives no counts, only the method: find shops via Touch Pad > Style and spend however you like.
disputes.call: Spend where the money is biggest — Ammu-Nation and Mod Shops — and let the long tail of small shops finish the total naturally.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app for $160,000 total. The four garages the story gives you do not count. Push Square prices every one, so you can save to the exact dollar.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) to unlock the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
Press Up, open the phone, and launch the Vice City Real Estate app.
Raise $160,000 first — Randy deliveries, vault robberies, and fencing are the fastest legal-ish income.
Buy the Mitchel Auto Center garage for $4,000 — the cheapest of the eight purchases that total $160,000.
Buy the Persistence Road Garage for $7,600.
Buy the 7th Avenue Garage for $12,000.
Buy the Store n' Bolt garage for $16,800.
Buy Wyatt Motors for $21,600 and the Vela Rota Drive Garage for $24,000.
Buy the Bonita Court Garage for $34,000 and the Atlantic Court Garage for $40,000.
Ignore the four story-given garages in your count — only the eight purchases advance the trophy.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase, at exactly $160,000 spent.
Use the eight new parking spots immediately for On the Spot registrations.
Each purchased garage adds exactly one parking spot — eight purchases, eight spots.
Ring-fence the $160,000 before spending freely on hairstyles, clothes, or tattoos — those purchases compete for the same cash.

disputes.a: Push Square prices all eight garages individually, from $4,000 to $40,000, totalling exactly $160,000.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, GTABase, and games.gg give only the total — 8 garages, about $160,000 — without the per-garage prices.
disputes.call: Save to Push Square's itemised $160,000 and buy in its price order; the totals agree everywhere.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with Moses in Chapter 2. Register stolen vehicles through him — Respray, then Register — and use cheap cars and bikes, because every registration costs money and needs a free garage spot.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) mission to install the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) so every registration has a free parking spot waiting.
Steal a cheap car or bike with no tracker fitted.
Drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Pay the registration fee — cheap vehicles keep the fee small.
Repeat with nine more tracker-free vehicles until the count reaches ten.
From Chapter 3, Standard Tracker vehicles can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray, widening your pool.
Confirm each registration inside the Scooter Bros app before stealing the next vehicle.
The trophy pops on the tenth registered vehicle.
Keep registered vehicles afterwards — Scooter Bros delivers them back to you repaired for a small fee.
Expect the registration fee to scale with the vehicle's value — one more reason to register cheap cars and bikes, not supercars.

disputes.a: Push Square says vehicles you're driving can be registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop at any time, as long as you have empty parking spots.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, GTABase, OutputLag, and games.gg route the early registrations through Moses in Port Gellhorn (Respray, then Register), with Pay 'n' Spray registration for tracked cars only opening in Chapter 3.
disputes.call: Start at Moses as the detailed guides describe; try a Pay 'n' Spray only from Chapter 3, and fall back to Moses if it refuses.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a VCIA boarding bridge — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. Terminals E3 and E4 are the easiest. The pop is delayed until you are about a kilometre out.

steps.t: Save manually before attempting this — the police response at the airport is fast.
Travel to VCIA and head for terminals E3 or E4, where passenger jets sit docked at boarding bridges.
Ignore any plane parked out on the open airfield; only a jet connected to a boarding bridge counts.
Reach the jet via the stairs beside the boarding bridge, or walk through the terminal on foot.
Go upstairs inside the jet and take the cockpit.
Reverse the jet away from the bridge and taxi onto the runway.
Take off at full throttle before the police can block the runway.
Fly straight out until you are about 1 km (0.6 mi) from the airport.
Keep flying — the pop is delayed and lands once the distance registers.
If you are shot down before 1 km, reload your save and repeat from E3/E4.
To reach the terminal doors from outside, drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
You already know this airport from Chapter 4's VCIA Takedown — reuse the same terminal layout and stairs.

disputes.a: Every detailed guide agrees the jet must be docked at a boarding bridge, with E3/E4 the named easy gates.
disputes.b: OutputLag additionally warns to save first because the police come fast — a step the other guides leave implicit.
disputes.call: Docked jet, E3 or E4, save first, and fly a full kilometre out before expecting the pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos are military tanks parked at the south of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the map's south-west edge. Get inside one and take out enemies from the turret until it pops.

steps.t: Save manually before entering the base — a tank theft draws a heavy response.
Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
Enter through the main gate, or use the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance to get inside.
Head to the south of the base where the tanks are parked.
Climb into a Rhino tank before the base personnel pin you down.
Use the tank's cannon against the responding enemies — kills must come from inside the tank.
