Keep firing on new responders rather than fleeing; the pop is tied to taking out enemies from inside the tank.
The trophy pops once enough enemies have been taken out from the Rhino.
If the tank is disabled, fall back, let the heat drop, and re-enter the base for another one.

disputes.a: OutputLag places Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and GTABase place it on the island at the south-western edge of the map, in Mariana County.
disputes.call: Both descriptions point at the same south-west island base — head for the tanks parked at its south end and the geography argument becomes moot.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Gang Operation, first marked by Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling. Steal its three key valuables — the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the safe's contents — then lose the police. It does not need to happen in one run.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling so the Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn is marked.
Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation before you go — the safe needs them.
Enter Kingpin Bowling and head for the office in the south-east of the building.
Take the luxury watch, shown with a golden icon, from the south-east office.
Move to the north-east corner and take the unique shotgun variant, the Gutterball Moreland 850, from the table.
Find the safe in the north-east hallway office and blow it open with a sticky bomb.
Loot the safe's contents — that is the third and final key valuable.
You do not need to kill the enemies inside; the valuables are the objective.
Escape the police response completely — the trophy only pops after you lose them.
If you missed a valuable, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and rob the alley again — it is not missable and need not be one run.
Confirm all three valuables across your runs; the pop lands on the escape after the third is banked.
Count this robbery toward Pest Control and the checklist too — Kingpin Bowling is one of the 39 Gang Operations.

disputes.a: games.gg confirms valuables collected on earlier visits still count if you return during a later robbery.
disputes.b: PowerPyx notes the robbery icon takes a long time to respawn if you miss one, which can make a single-run clear feel mandatory.
disputes.call: Try for all three in one run, but if one slips, wait out the respawn and finish it on the revisit — nothing is lost.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together: the partner you are not controlling works out alongside you and gains Strength too, halving the grind. Fitness clubs are on the map under Activities.

steps.t: Check both Strength meters under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon) and note who is behind.
Wait until partner play is open after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — training together needs both characters present.
Call your partner: hold Right on the D-pad, then press Triangle / Y.
Open Map > Activities and travel to a fitness club together.
Work out on the club equipment — your idle partner trains automatically alongside you, so both Strength meters rise.
Alternate who you control between sessions so neither character lags behind.
Recheck both Strength meters after every session under Jason & Lucia > Strength.
After the story, home workouts also count if a club trip is inconvenient.
Keep training until both Jason and Lucia sit at maximum Strength simultaneously.
The trophy pops the moment the second character's Strength maxes while the first is still maxed.

disputes.a: OutputLag adds a concrete method: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
disputes.b: PowerPyx describes the same doubling effect through fitness clubs and post-story home workouts, without mentioning a membership.
disputes.call: Train together at a fitness club — membership or not, paired sessions are the agreed accelerator.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it constantly, so most players earn this without a dedicated grind — just never push the profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent.

steps.t: Open Settings > UI > HUD Notifications and turn on Criminal Profile so the demon-face icon reports every counted action.
Select this trophy in your trophy list to see its live progress counter.
Play Stage 2 normally — robberies, escapes, and enemy encounters all feed the counter.
Lean Professional where you can: stealth finishes, destroying evidence, and clean escapes all count.
Hardened actions count too: incapacitating enemies and limb shots move the total.
Violent and Psycho actions count as well, but they steer the profile toward police attention.
Never chase the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent, and police shoot on sight far more often.
Check the counter after each robbery session; 500 arrives well before the checklist grind ends.
If you are short late in the run, chain Gang Operations — dense fights plus a robbery per site fill the counter fastest.
The trophy pops on the five-hundredth profile-affecting action.

disputes.a: PowerPyx quantifies the trophy at 500 Criminal-Profile-affecting actions and documents the five profile types.
disputes.b: The flat lists print only the cryptic description — Choices made (for better or worse) — with no count or system named.
disputes.call: Trust the quantified account: turn the Criminal Profile notifications on and let normal Stage 2 crime carry you to 500.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: One of the five unsolved hidden trophies. The description points at a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach; GTAScoop's lead names the Ocean View Rooftop Bar. Treat it as unconfirmed and try the rooftop first.

steps.t: Mark this trophy UNCONFIRMED in your plan — no guide has a verified trigger yet.
Travel to Ocean Beach in Vice City and look for a rooftop bar with a sea view.
Go up to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, GTAScoop's named lead for this trophy.
Order a cocktail at the bar and drink it while facing the ocean view.
If nothing pops, try ordering at other Ocean Beach bars and rooftops with a view.
Try it at different times of day — a sunset cocktail is the classic reading of the description.
Try it with both Jason and Lucia; some one-off feats are character-specific.
If it pops, note the exact bar and time — the trigger is still being crowdsourced by every guide.
Combine the trip with WAiNK landmark scans around Ocean Beach — the district is dense with scannable locations.
No trophy database lists a method for this one — the description is all anyone has, so treat each Ocean Beach bar visit as a live experiment.

disputes.a: GTAScoop offers a specific lead: drink a cocktail on the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, and links a guide for it.
disputes.b: GTABase and GTA Zone say the exact steps are not confirmed yet, offering only that the description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
disputes.call: Start at GTAScoop's rooftop bar — it is the only named location — but keep expectations at unconfirmed until it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unsolved and unconfirmed. Every guide reads the description the same way: get a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the showroom window. No verified location or method exists yet.

steps.t: Mark this trophy UNCONFIRMED — the trigger is believed, not verified, in every source.
Find a vehicle showroom with a display car inside and a full glass frontage.
Get into the display car inside the showroom.
Drive the car straight out through the showroom's front window, in classic style.
Escape the area afterwards in case the stunt draws a wanted level.
If nothing pops, repeat at other showrooms — the specific showroom may matter.
Try it with a car you drove in yourself if display cars cannot be entered.
If it pops, record which showroom worked — no guide can yet confirm the spot.
No trophy database lists a verified method for this one — the description is the only evidence anyone has.

disputes.a: GTABase says the description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom.
disputes.b: GTA Zone labels the same reading explicitly unconfirmed, and GTAScoop files it only as reportedly a showroom smash-out.
disputes.call: Attempt the showroom window exit — it is the unanimous reading — but budget it as a lottery ticket, not a checklist item.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unsolved. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. PowerPyx's best lead ties it to a Payday Loans store robbed during the Prologue — treat every attempt as a guess until the community cracks it.

steps.t: Mark this trophy UNCONFIRMED — no source has a verified trigger.
Read the description literally: something must fail once, then succeed on the second attempt.
Follow PowerPyx's lead and rob the Payday Loans store featured in the Prologue if you revisit that area.
When any robbery or job fails, immediately retry it rather than moving on — second-attempt successes are the suspected trigger family.
Retry failed races and challenges back-to-back for the same reason.
Keep a note of what you retried and when, so a pop can be matched to its cause.
Do not burn hours here — park it until a verified method surfaces, and let normal retries accumulate.
Nothing else on the list is missable, so retry-based theories can be tested freely without risking the run.
No trophy database lists a verified method for this one — the description is the only evidence anyone has.

disputes.a: PowerPyx offers the only concrete lead: the trophy is believed to involve a Payday Loans store robbed during the Prologue.
disputes.b: GTABase, GTA Zone, and GTAScoop all list the trigger as simply not known yet, reading the description as succeeding at something on a second attempt.
disputes.call: Note the Payday Loans lead, retry failed jobs immediately as a habit, and accept this one may only fall to luck or a future community solve.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unsolved, with two live leads from OutputLag: a glowing-graffiti code room in Crosstown that opens a safe, and Lucia's Chapter 2 UFO abduction side story tied to a keypad at the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake. Neither is confirmed.

steps.t: Mark this trophy UNCONFIRMED — it is one of the five hidden trophies with no verified trigger at launch.
Lead one: travel to Crosstown and find the Pawn & Gun store.
Enter the building across the street, east of the Pawn & Gun, and check its stairwell room.
If the room fills with glowing graffiti, photograph or write down the six-digit code it hides — the room may only appear once.
Use the code on the safe on the ground floor of the same building.
Lead two: as Lucia in Chapter 2, pursue the UFO abduction side story when it surfaces.
Travel to the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake and try its keypad.
Note that the Abandoned Site code fails for many players — if it fails, bank the attempt and move on.
Keep exploring strange map events during cleanup; the description promises something weird, wherever it lives.
No trophy database lists a verified method for this one — the description is the only evidence anyone has.

disputes.a: OutputLag publishes two specific leads: the Crosstown glowing-graffiti code and safe, and Lucia's UFO abduction story with the Abandoned Site keypad.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, GTABase, and GTA Zone list the trophy as wholly unconfirmed, expecting only a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida.
disputes.call: Work OutputLag's two leads in order — Crosstown first, it is cheap — while treating both as unverified until one pops it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unsolved. The description demands knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. PowerPyx's best guess is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. Unconfirmed in every source.

steps.t: Mark this trophy UNCONFIRMED — the precise method is still being confirmed everywhere.
Get on a motorcycle — the leading theory involves kicking from a bike.
Ride slowly past a group of pedestrians or enemies at melee range.
Throw a melee attack from the bike as you pass, knocking a target down without stopping.
Repeat passes until several people have been bowled over by the drive-by melee.
Try enemy targets at a Gang Operation if pedestrians do not register.
Try the same from a car window with a melee weapon if the bike kick does nothing.
If it pops, note the vehicle and target type — the method is still an open question in every guide.
No trophy database lists a verified method for this one — the description is the only evidence anyone has.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's believed method is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
disputes.b: KeenGamer and GTA Zone state only that a melee drive-by is required and the precise method is unconfirmed, with no vehicle specified.
disputes.call: Start on the motorcycle — it is the only concrete lead — and vary vehicle and target type until something registers.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum: earn all 54 other trophies and this pops automatically. On Xbox the same achievement is the 0G Mythic. Plan the whole run at roughly 200 hours — story 60–80, checklist about 100, cleanup about 10.

steps.t: Earn every other trophy in this tracker — the Platinum has no requirement of its own.
Use the Missables tab to confirm Positive Mental Attitude is banked before you leave Chapter 1.
Finish the story first (Stage 1) so the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats.
Grind the checklist to 100% for A Long Road — it is the longest single block of the run.
Close the six side-story finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) during Stage 2.
Finish eight counting Strangers & Freaks strands and verify them against the trophy counter.
Sweep the Stage 3 secrets last, accepting the five unconfirmed trophies may need community solves.
Never use cheats on this save at any point — they disable trophies and saving.
Keep the chapter-boundary saves until the Platinum pops; there is no mission replay to fix a late mistake.
When the 54th other trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! pops automatically — congratulations, Leonida Legend.
The run's difficulty is rated 4/10 and there are no difficulty settings to choose — the challenge is time, not skill gates.
Budget the run in three blocks: story 60–80 hours, the 100% checklist around 100 hours, then Strangers and cleanup at 10–20 hours.
Seven missions plus all four chapter endings carry the story trophies — the rest of the campaign is trophy-free cruising.
No mission anywhere requires a gold medal — finish missions cleanly rather than perfectly.
The game has 61 cheats and none of them work before the credits; each unlocks after the story with its own requirement.
If you ever test a cheat on a throwaway save, the trophy block lasts only that session — your clean save stays clean.

disputes.a: Most guides budget the Platinum at about 200 hours, split 60–80 story, ~100 checklist, ~10 cleanup.
disputes.b: Push Square warns to set aside up to 300 hours or more, and Press Start estimates full completion at 100+ hours with the story around 50.
disputes.call: Plan around 200 hours as the working estimate, but do not book the Platinum for a fixed date — Push Square's 300 is the honest worst case.
